name: Bizzabo
description: Bizzabo is an event experience platform for planning, marketing and delivering conferences, field events, webinars and other in-person, virtual and hybrid programs. Event teams use it for registration, websites, agenda and speaker management, onsite experiences, networking, engagement, integrations and analytics.
agentUseSummary: Connect a customer-owned Bizzabo API credential through Railway's encrypted boundary, then let selected agents list one bounded event page or inspect one exact event without registrant, attendee or engagement data.

credentialRequirements.name: BIZZABO_API_KEY
credentialRequirements.label: Bizzabo API key
credentialRequirements.helpText: Create the credential in the customer's Bizzabo API/Integrations area after confirming Open API plan access.

capabilities.label: Read event metadata
capabilities.description: List bounded Bizzabo event summaries and inspect one exact event without people or engagement data.

allowed.label: List events
allowed.description: List at most twenty-five Bizzabo event summaries from page zero.

allowed.label: Read an event
allowed.description: Read one exact Bizzabo event metadata summary.

blocked.label: Block people data
blocked.description: Contacts, registrants, attendees, speakers, partners, badges, engagement and analytics are not exposed.

blocked.label: Block mutations
blocked.description: Event, agenda, session, registration, attendee and webhook writes are not exposed.

blocked.label: Block raw API
blocked.description: Arbitrary endpoints, automatic pagination, bulk operations and raw responses are not exposed.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Bounded event reads run directly; people, engagement, writes, bulk and raw access remain blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: The same selected read surface runs without Relay per-action approval; credential ownership, fixed origin, bounds and redaction still apply.

runtimeSupport.description: Relay mounts two typed Bizzabo event reads and attaches the encrypted credential only to the fixed API origin.
Relay mounts two typed Bizzabo event reads and attaches the encrypted credential only to the fixed API origin.

providerSetup.blocker: Customer plan/API access, an account-created API credential and live confirmation of the account's current API version are required.
providerSetup.nextAction: In the separate provider-console task, confirm Open API plan access, create the customer credential, store it encrypted, confirm the current documented API version/origin in the account docs, validate the two bounded reads, revoke provider-side on disconnect, and confirm subsequent denial.

evidence.supports: Bizzabo advertises an Open API for connecting event data to customer technology.
Bizzabo lists Open API access as a plan capability that customers use to build solutions and connectors.
Bizzabo documents TLS 1.2 in transit, AES-256 at rest and logical customer-data segregation.
